name: withdrawchan-local-integration
description: Local orchestration for the original WithdrawChan engine and Zola website

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix src/js && npm ci --prefix web && npm run setup --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix src/js && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.check: npm run build --prefix src/js && npm run check --prefix web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --prefix src/js && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:engine: npm run build --prefix src/js && npm test --prefix src/js
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm test --prefix web
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run preview
